snippet.title: ZWAARD Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Craft your ultimate sword by scavenging parts in a post-apocalyptic world. Navigate an expansive open world, relying on the might of your customized blade to overcome dangerous species infected by mysterious technology. This trailer was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251170/ZWAARD/
